task_completion.description: Open the 'Turbine Simulation' project from the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The QBlade application window shows 'Turbine Simulation' in the title bar or project explorer, and the 3D view displays a wind turbine model.

task_completion.description: Set simulation to 'Single Point' with Wind Speed 12 m/s and TSR 7.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The simulation setup panel shows 'Single Point' selected, 'Wind Speed' input box containing '12', and 'TSR' input box containing '7'.

task_completion.description: Enable Tip Loss and Hub Loss corrections in the simulation settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Checkboxes or dropdowns for 'Tip Loss' and 'Hub Loss' are marked as active/checked in the simulation configuration menu.
A progress bar completes, or a results graph/table appears showing spanwise data (Normal and Tangential forces) after clicking 'Start' or 'Simulate'.

task_completion.description: Export the spanwise load data to /home/ga/Documents/spanwise_loads.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog box is visible with the file path '/home/ga/Documents/spanwise_loads.txt' entered, or a confirmation message of successful export is shown.

task_completion.description: Identify the maximum Normal Force and save it to /home/ga/Documents/max_load_report.txt in the correct format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows the file /home/ga/Documents/max_load_report.txt containing the string 'Max_Fn = <value>'.

integrity.description: The agent used the QBlade GUI to perform the simulation rather than script-injecting results.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with QBlade menus, buttons, and input fields rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The maximum load value is derived from the simulation results, not hardcoded.
integrity.visual_evidence: The value in the final report matches the peak value visible in the QBlade results graph or data table shown in previous steps.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific file paths requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file manager or save dialogs explicitly show the /home/ga/Documents/ directory and the specific filenames requested.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The project file is 'Turbine Simulation.wpa'. The simulation must be 'Single Point' BEM. Wind Speed = 12, TSR = 7. Tip and Hub loss must be enabled. The output file 'spanwise_loads.txt' should contain columns for Position, Normal Force (Fn), and Tangential Force (Ft). The report 'max_load_report.txt' must strictly follow the format 'Max_Fn = <value>'. Note that Normal Force (Fn) in QBlade is typically measured in N/m.
